offering_description.value: Operates bowling centers, arcades, family entertainment centers and water parks for consumers and groups. Its venues sell food and drinks and host leagues, parties and corporate events. It also runs professional bowling competitions for players, fans and media partners.

primary_products.value: Prepared food; alcoholic and nonalcoholic beverages

primary_services.value: Recreational and league bowling; arcade and family attractions; water park admission; private event hosting; professional bowling competitions

customer_segment.value: B2C: Recreational bowlers, league players, families, park visitors, party hosts and professional bowling fans; B2B: Employers and event planners booking group outings, plus broadcasters and sponsors of professional bowling

end_markets.value: Location-based recreation; corporate and private events; professional sports and sports media

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Bowling sessions, shoe rentals, arcade play and attraction admissions; product sales: Food and beverages purchased at venues; service fees: Hosted party packages, corporate outings and league participation; advertising: Sponsorship and promotional placements around professional bowling; licensing or royalties: Media rights for professional bowling coverage
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees; advertising; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Runs bowling centers, family entertainment venues and water parks for visitors and groups; service provider: Uses venue staff and facilities to host group events and stages bowling tournaments for players and audiences

geography_served.value: North America: Venues primarily in the United States, with operations in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Bowling centers, arcades, family entertainment centers, water parks and professional bowling

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated bowling centers, family entertainment centers and water parks; online: Company websites for lane reservations, admission tickets and event inquiries; direct sales: Group sales teams booking corporate outings and private events; partners / resellers: Broadcast and streaming partners carrying professional bowling competitions
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Local food safety inspections, state and local liquor licensing, and aquatic facility safety rules

notes: Current operations in Mexico are uncertain.
